逐項完成本階段動作，在結果表保留輸入、公式或狀態轉移、輸出及版本。將每個輸出對到以下判準，不能以「已做完」代替工程證據：圖上須能追蹤輸入至交付端。由地面移動速度與曝光時間估算拖影，與像素尺度分開評估。

Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter makes high-resolution observations of Mars, with image quality influenced by geometry, optics and motion. Draw an interface map after checking the source. Connect ground speed, look direction, exposure timing and returned pixels, noting GSD is not complete resolution.
Carry out each action and retain inputs, formulas or state transitions, outputs, and revision. Map every output to the following criterion; completing an activity is not acceptance evidence: The diagram must trace the input to its recipient. Estimate motion smear from ground speed and exposure, separately from pixel scale.
